notes:
Redesigns the Custom Site Settings window to more closely match the Cumination add-on settings layout, including left-side tabs, grouped sections and OK/Cancel controls.

Adds a Senderliste erstellen tab with playlist Create and Update actions placed side by side under a dedicated section heading.

Adds Simple IPTV integration for creating or reusing an Adult IPTV PVR IPTV Simple configuration with the configured m3u4u playlist and EPG URLs.

Adds a Simple IPTV Update action that temporarily disables the Adult IPTV configuration, refreshes Kodi PVR/EPG data and re-enables the configuration, with safeguards when other PVR clients are active.

Adds an install button for PVR IPTV Simple Client when the add-on is not installed.

Moves the existing Senderstatus prüfen controls into a dedicated second tab without changing the existing site-check logic.

Adds Simple IPTV Prüfen to test all Adult TV Test channels through Kodi PVR/IPTV Simple and log per-channel startup timing plus summary statistics for later performance analysis.

Existing streaming, playlist resolver, thumbnail, Landscape Wall and update-check behavior remain otherwise unchanged from v1.89.

This is an experimental pre-release and may contain bugs or incomplete features.
